card.title: Sell the Disaster
card.instruction: Make a terrible plan sound sensible, responsible, and inevitable.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Removing the restaurant roof is our only affordable way to fix the ventilation.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We close. A responsible business protects its customers.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Rain is forecast all opening week.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we'll save a week's wages. Put that toward umbrellas; we can't afford to abandon the savings now.

mechanism: A frames removing a restaurant roof as necessary thrift and reinterprets rain consequences as responsible savings.
confusable: Unlike mere optimism, A must justify a bad plan through responsibility and increasing inability to abandon it.
comparison: D17-a turns closure into wage savings committed to umbrellas; D17-b turns absent bidders into a duty to borrow more and bid.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
